title: Engine configuration registry file (D-068)
description: Every config/registry/<owner>.json satisfies this schema. The file is itself a JSON Schema object: each property is one parameter named <owner>.<snake_case_key> for what it controls, with its type, default, valid range, unit, description and readers.

$id.description: The file's path from the repository root.

x-owner.description: The owner; equals the file name and prefixes every parameter name.

x-schema-version.description: Raised when a revision removes a deprecated parameter (expand→contract).

default.description: The registry value; the store may override it (scripts/config set).

x-unit.description: s, ms, count, percent, lines, tokens, bytes, regex, path, enum, text, flag, ...

x-readers.description: The path of each file that reads the parameter; each must exist.

x-flag.description: A feature flag (D-069 item 11); its type is boolean.

x-text.description: User-facing text (D-069 item 15); its value is keyed by locale.

x-text-context.description: Where the text appears and what it says to the reader, for whoever translates it (L1, additive).

x-source.description: Where the default comes from: a decision, premise or document.

x-monotonic.description: The direction a numeric threshold may only tighten in: max is a ceiling (raising it loosens), min a floor (lowering it loosens); judged against the base by scripts/lib/threshold_check.py (D-069 item 14, TH1).

x-literal-names.description: Identifiers that spell this parameter in code that predates the registry.

x-literal-sites.description: path:identifier of each literal not yet read from the registry; the list only shrinks.

deprecated.description: Marked before the parameter is removed (expand→contract).
